WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)

    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, false
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key

    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)

       SUM(net_sales) AS sept_net, COUNT(*) AS n

SELECT CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN 'web' WHEN store_id=999 THEN 'train' ELSE 'stores' END AS part,
       SUM(net_sales) AS ctl_net, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) AS days, MIN(business_date), MAX(business_date)
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.category, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN net_sales END) AS s999,
       SUM(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN net_sales END) AS zz,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' THEN net_sales END) AS p05,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' THEN net_sales END) AS sept
FROM net_lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
